description: This file defines an internal abstract class 'Striped64' used for maintaining a lazily-initialized table of atomically updated variables with contention management, used as a base for concurrent counters or similar structures in the Orleans.Caching.Internal namespace.

classes.name: Striped64
classes.description: An internal abstract class managing a thread-safe, striped table of atomic variables with contention handling mechanisms, serving as a base for concurrent counters.

classes.name: Striped64.Cell
classes.description: A nested sealed class representing a padded atomic long value used within the striped table to reduce cache contention.

methods.name: CasCellsBusy
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock for resizing or initializing the table by CAS on '_cellsBusy'.

methods.name: VolatileWriteNotBusy
methods.description: Releases the lock set by 'CasCellsBusy' by setting '_cellsBusy' to zero.

methods.name: GetProbe
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's probe value, based on 'CurrentManagedThreadId'.

methods.name: AdvanceProbe
methods.description: Randomly advances the thread's probe value using xorshift, to assist in collision handling.

methods.name: LongAccumulate
methods.description: Handles contention by attempting CAS updates on cells or base; expands the table when necessary; manages contention through retries and resizing logic.
